title: Item Durability HUD
description: !FABRIC! A lightweight mod that displays your held item's durability directly above the hotbar in a simple Current/Max format. Keep track of your tools without opening your inventory!
body:
Simple Durability HUD is a lightweight and essential utility mod designed for players who want to keep track of their gear's health without any distractions.
Instead of constantly opening your inventory or guessing based on the durability bar, this mod displays the exact numeric values (Current/Max) of the item you are currently holding. The information is conveniently placed right above your hotbar, so it stays visible during gameplay but doesn't clutter your screen.

Key Features:

1. Real-time Tracking: See your tool's durability update instantly as you use it.

2. Minimalist Design: Clean numeric format (32/32) that fits perfectly with the vanilla Minecraft UI.

3. Optimized Performance: Built specifically for Fabric, ensuring it won't impact your FPS.
 
Perfect for miners, builders, and adventurers who want to avoid the frustration of their favorite tools breaking unexpectedly.
